Interrogative
Negative
I have been in Europe for 2 weeks.
How long have you been in Europe?
I have not been in Europe for 2 weeks.
She has won many awards so far.
Has she ever won any awards?
She, hasn’t won any awards yet.
They have stayed in many lodges around the world.
Have they stayed in many lodges around the world?
They haven’t stayed in many lodges around the world.
There are also some adverbs that work with this structure
I have already been here for 6 hours.
She has just entered the hotel.
You have not called them yet.

texts: To Consider
1. Already – used to determine longer periods of time in actions.
2. Just – Used to determine shorter periods of time in actions.
3.  Yet –Used to state an actions has not occurred.
4. ALL of them can be in questions and sentences (yet only in questions and negative ones)
5. Have/Has are the auxiliaries. Main verbs must be in past participle.
6. There is a progressive tense that can be used here. E.G I have been waiting for the bus for two hours

texts: Functional English
We can use present perfect tense to communicate different functions. Check out the following examples.
Functions
Examples
Express actions that started in the past and still continue.
They have visited us for two weeks already.
You have been tall since you were a child.
Talk about actions than happened only once or certain times.
He has just been there once.
We have stayed at your place many times.
State unfinished actions
We have been expecting him to change for so long.
Point out finished actions

-Why are you so tired? 
-I’ve been getting ready for the test all week.

texts: B. Listen to the audio and answer the questions your teacher makes.
Such a great life!

John is 25 years old. In such a young life, he has known many places. He has been in Europe for the last two weeks; he has gone sightseeing every day and he has already visited many places. Today, he has not gone out of the hotel yet, but he has just had breakfast so he is getting ready to go out. He has been to other places in his life and he has seen and stayed in a range of inns, boarding houses, lodges etc. around the world. He’s living his life the way he has planned and so far, he has gotten and achieved all what he wanted. This trip will finish the upcoming Friday, but he is already planning what to do for the upcoming holidays.

John is 25 years old. In such a young life, he has known many places. He has been in Europe for the last two weeks; he has gone sightseeing every day and he has already visited many places. Today, he has not gone out of the hotel yet, but he has just had breakfast so he is getting ready to go out. He has been to other places in his life and he has seen and stayed in a range of inns, boarding houses, lodges etc. around the world. He’s living his life the way he has planned and so far, he has gotten and achieved all what he wanted. This trip will finish the upcoming Friday, but he is already planning what to do for the upcoming holidays.
